name: comp_drum_bus_gentle
description: Drum bus glue — gentle (preserves LRA for downstream clipper / parallel sat)
notes: Same SSL G-Bus shape as comp_drum_bus but ratio 2:1 instead of 4:1, threshold -8 instead of -10, makeup 0 not auto. Target: < 1 dB of gain reduction on most material. Use when downstream mastering / make-it-hit tools need >4 LU LRA to function. The aggressive comp_drum_bus often crushes LRA below 4, blocking master clipper and parallel saturation relevance checks.
